description: Use this when the traveler confirms a quoted departure and wants to book. Returns a short-lived link to a review page on seesight-tours.com that restores the product, departure, party and currency; the guest confirms the final total there and pays on the website at the website price. This tool reserves and charges nothing and stores nothing: the same quote_id always returns the same link. Never ask for card or contact details in chat.

quote_id.description: The opaque price-lock reference from check_availability (valid for 15 minutes).
